meta.name: pitch-launch
meta.description: Produce an actual launch plan with announcement copy, channel sequence, and day-1 checklist. Use when asked to "plan a launch", "GTM strategy", "how do we announce this", "launch plan for [feature]", "go-to-market", "write our Product Hunt post", or "how do we get people to notice this".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 策划产品发布，生成公告文案与渠道排期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正筹备产品上线需要发布计划。
copy.tagline_en: Create a launch plan with announcement copy and channel sequence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a go-to-market plan for a product launch.

howto.what: 当你要发布新产品或功能时，Claude会生成一套完整的发布计划，包括公告文案、渠道排期和首日检查清单，文案直接可对外发布。
howto.when: 当你提出“计划发布”、“GTM策略”、“如何宣布这个”、“[功能]的发布计划”等请求时触发。

say.text: 我们要发布一个AI写作助手，帮我做发布计划。
规划首日检查清单，有负责人那种。
say.note: Claude会列出邮件、社媒、产品支持等各项任务并指定角色。

howto.what_en: When you need to launch a product or feature, Claude generates a complete launch plan with announcement copy, channel timing, and a day-1 checklist—copy is ready to publish directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "plan a launch", "GTM strategy", "how do we announce this" or similar requests related to a product launch.

say_en.text: We're launching an AI writing assistant, help me plan the launch.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product details, then output a full launch plan.

say_en.text: Write a Product Hunt listing template.
say_en.note: Claude generates tagline, description, and first comment in PH format.

say_en.text: Create a day-1 checklist with owners.
say_en.note: Claude produces a checklist with named owners for each task.
